verdict.rationale: Postman documents a public Postman API for managing workspace assets programmatically. It also offers an Analytics API and pairs the API with the CLI for CI/CD toolchain integration, and a probe found a machine-readable OpenAPI document on the docs site. missing for 10: documented detail on endpoint coverage, auth and rate limits for agent-driven use, and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.
